name: Titicaca water frog
desc: A fully aquatic frog that eats mainly amphipods and snails, and adults also take Orestias fish. Overcollection, pollution and trout have cut its numbers.
about: Telmatobius culeus, commonly known as the Titicaca water frog or Lake Titicaca frog, is a medium-large to very large and endangered species of frog in the family Telmatobiidae.
